name: move-brief
title: Draft move brief
for_each: select id,name from plans order by name

sections.title: Floor allocation
sections.sql: select building,floor,people,seats,capacity,spare_seats from floor_load where plan_id=$1 order by building,floor

sections.title: Checks to resolve
sections.sql: select rule,subject,issue from space_exceptions where plan_id=$1

sections.title: Move checklist
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,status,evidence from move_tasks where plan_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where plan_id=$1 order by created_at

name: capacity-record
title: Draft workplace capacity record
for_each: select id,name from buildings order by name

sections.title: Emergency planning
sections.sql: select name,owner,emergency_ref,review_due from buildings where id=$1
sections.note: Recorded references are evidence prompts, not a certificate of legal compliance.

sections.title: Floor evidence
sections.sql: select name,capacity,area_sqm,capacity_ref from floors where building_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Observation history
sections.sql: select f.name floor,o.observed_on,o.present,o.method,o.evidence from observations o join floors f on f.id=o.floor_id where f.building_id=$1 order by o.observed_on desc
